summary: Frontend-only audit on mobile 430x900, guest flow (decline cookie banner, then practice-level-N, practice-start). All 20 arcade styles were auto-played with in-page solvers at Level 1 and Level 91 (tier 10, max difficulty), Shell Game included: 41/41 runs reached practice-pass and none got stuck. Shell Game now really shuffles. Cup style.left changed through 4 distinct position sets, phases go Watch -> Follow the cup -> 'Where is it? Tap a cup!' -> Found it!/Not there!, the next round starts automatically, and winning the goal rounds passes the level. A perfect-tracking bot won 5/5 at L91 with 5 cups and 14 swaps. Background music works: an <audio> element plays world0.mp3 at L1 and world1.mp3 at L6. music-toggle sits next to party-sound-toggle in the run header and in the party stage header (pty_ultimate_ttt). The OFF state persists in localStorage after reload with no play() call, and Quit/Back pauses the music. The 3-star celebration works: practice-celebration with 'PERFECT! ⭐⭐⭐' and heavy confetti appeared on every 3-star pass and never on 1-2 star passes. cheer1/cheer2.mp3 are fetched and AudioBufferSource.start fires on taps (14-19 per run). Jigsaw 3x3 and 4x4 load sharp 2048x2048 Unsplash photos, the image changes by level (L1 deer, L2 balloon), tiles render correctly and the puzzles are solvable (passed with 3 stars). Problems found: (1) the music OFF switch only fades volume to 0 and never pauses the audio; (2) Catch the Prizes and Dodge Runner count every catch/dodge twice in the dev/preview build; (3) some balance issues (Higher or Lower is nearly unwinnable at high tiers, 3 stars cannot be reached on Shell Game at tiers 9-10 or realistically on Treasure Dig); (4) small UX notes.

ui_bugs.issue: Turning music OFF never pauses the <audio> element. Measured after OFF and again 1s later: paused=false, volume=0, currentTime still advancing. Cause: setMusicEnabled calls stopMusic() (want=-1) and then right away restores want=w. When the ramp(0) callback runs, it checks `if (want < 0) a.pause()`, which is now false, so pause() is never called. On iOS Safari HTMLMediaElement.volume is read-only (always 1), so on iPhones the music KEEPS PLAYING AT FULL VOLUME after the user switches it off. It also streams/decodes for no reason. Fix: in the OFF branch call el.pause() directly (or pass a force flag to stopMusic) and keep `want` only for re-enabling. Fades are also ineffective on iOS, so stopMusic should call pause() promptly instead of relying on the volume ramp.

Score goes up by 2 per catch/dodge (observed Caught 0->2->4->6, Dodged 0->2). Misses are also counted twice. Cause: side effects (run.ping, setScore/setDodged) are called inside the setDrop/setObs updater functions, and React StrictMode (index.js) runs updaters twice in dev. Levels end in half the intended time in preview, and prod will behave differently from preview. Fix: keep the updaters pure. Compute caught/dodged from a ref (dropRef/obsRef) inside the interval callback, then call setScore/ping outside any updater.

Mostly luck and nearly unwinnable at high tiers. The goal is an unbroken streak (5 at d1, 12 at d10) and any wrong guess resets it. Even with the optimal strategy (higher if <50) the bot needed 43.1s of a 46s limit at L91, with accuracy 5% (the floor) at both L1 and L91. A human at about 1 guess/s will almost always time out at tiers 8-10, and 3 stars is effectively impossible at any level. Suggest a total-correct goal (not a streak), or a smaller streak plus no full reset, and not counting 50/50-type guesses as misses.

At tiers 9-10 (levels 81-100), 3 stars cannot be reached even with perfect play. 5 rounds x (1.9s show + 13-14 swaps x ~0.28-0.3s + 1.5s reveal) is about 36s, but 3 stars needs <=50% of the about 62-70s limit (31-35s). Measured: L91 perfect 5/5 took 36.1s at 100% accuracy and got no celebration. Also, wrong picks never fail the level: L1 passed after 9 wrong picks (2 stars, accuracy 25%). There is also a 1-frame jump at round start, because ball starts as 0 and is then randomised in the effect.

Accuracy treats normal exploration as mistakes. TreasureDig pings 'bad' for every dig with distance >1, and total=6, so accuracy is about 5% in most runs (L1 and L91) and 3 stars is unreachable. MemoryFlip counts unavoidable first-time mismatches: a perfect-memory bot scored 63-75%, which is below the 80% needed for 3 stars at 6-8 pairs.

There is no cooldown per pass. Every tap while the marker is inside the zone counts as a hit, so mashing finishes 6 beats in 0.5s (L1) or 3.7s (L91) with 100% accuracy and 3 stars. Allow only 1 hit per pass through the zone.

issues: photo-1497531551184 (level 2) and photo-1517520267752 (level 10) are hot-air balloons on plain blue sky. 4 or more 3x3 tiles (more at 4x4) are near-identical solid blue, so the correct position is ambiguous and frustrating. Replace them with detail-rich photos. 2 of the 10 photos are also similar colourful-street shots.
Gravity logic is correct (a tapped column shifts down and refills from the top), but the change is instant, with no pop or fall animation, so it is hard to see what happened.

The arcade theme rotates every level ((level-1)%8), but the music world changes every 5 levels. 'Music per theme world' does not match the visible theme, e.g. L2 Cosmic Quest plays world0. The URL theme suffix (arc_find_odd_space) is ignored by design: L1 always shows Fruit Fiesta.

action_items: HIGH: music.js setMusicEnabled(false) must actually pause() the audio (iOS ignores volume, so OFF currently does nothing on iPhone).
HIGH: CatchFall/DodgeRunner: move side effects (ping, setScore/setDodged) out of the setDrop/setObs updaters. StrictMode double-counts every catch, dodge and miss.
MEDIUM: Rebalance Higher or Lower (streak goal is near-unwinnable at tiers 8-10, accuracy always 5%).
MEDIUM: Shell Game: make 3 stars reachable at tiers 9-10 (shorter swaps/reveal or a relaxed star ratio), and consider failing or penalising after N wrong picks.
LOW: TreasureDig/MemoryFlip accuracy should not count normal exploration as misses. Add a per-pass cooldown to RhythmTap.
LOW: Replace the 2 plain-sky balloon jigsaw photos. Add a pop/fall animation to Bubble Burst. Consider syncing the music world with the arcade theme.
critical_code_review_comments: stylesA.jsx L33-41 and L108-113: setState updaters with side effects (React updaters must be pure).
music.js L25: the `want` restore after stopMusic stops the pause() in ramp's callback from ever running. stopMusic depends on volume fades, which do not work on iOS.

party/stage.jsx L34: startMusic has no cleanup and relies on PracticeRun's unmount to stop the music. If PartyStage is used outside PracticeRun (contest PlayGame), the music will keep playing after leaving.
ShellGame: ball initial state 0 plus the random set in the effect gives a 1-frame prize flash under cup 0. In StrictMode the effect runs twice (whoosh plays twice in dev).

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all 20 arcade games, celebration, jigsaw and music start/stop/persist pass; music OFF and double-count bugs fail)

seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage pl-practice-progress was set inside the test browser (guest) to unlock levels 6/91. No DB data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Practice arcade ids are arc_<style> (theme = THEME_IDS[(level-1)%8], difficulty = ceil(level/10)). To jump to level N as a guest: set localStorage pl-practice-progress = {'arc_<style>': {unlocked: N, stars: {}}} and reload. The tier containing `unlocked` is expanded; others are collapsed. Reusable harness: exec(open('/app/tests/arcade_audit_runner.py').read()); await run_arcade(page, [styles], level=N, bad='<theme bad emoji>'). It injects /app/tests/arcade_solvers.js. /app/tests/arcade_audit_init.js hooks HTMLMediaElement.play/pause (window.__lastAudio, window.__music) and AudioBufferSource.start (window.__bufStarts). Use it with page.add_init_script before goto. Retest: music OFF -> __lastAudio.paused should be true; Caught/Dodged should increase by 1 per event.
rca of the issue: Double count: CatchFall setDrop(updater) and DodgeRunner setObs(updater) call setScore/setDodged/run.ping inside the updater. React 18 StrictMode runs updaters twice in development, so +2 per event. Music OFF: setMusicEnabled(false) -> stopMusic() sets want=-1 and starts ramp(0, cb) -> the next line sets want=w (>=0) -> cb sees want>=0 and skips a.pause(). The audio element keeps playing at volume 0 (and at full volume on iOS, where volume is ignored).
